question: at fixed current value, does the VOR/SCAR value ratio depend on age?

value_removed_residual_check.method: ratio minus quadratic fit in log(SCAR value); a pure value effect would leave no age signal

reading: the gradient is monotone from <=21 down to 28-30 and holds at every bin count and after value is removed entirely, so it is a real career-stage effect, not value composition. Mechanism: the ratio is not a pure function of production (corr(log v, ratio)=0.71, residual sd 0.108 vs total 0.156), because value also flows through the gamma-refit v0 surface — young players lean on that prior, older players on realised production.

nonvacuity.synthetic_flat_input: a ratio identically 1.0 yields a flat gradient by construction
